notes.title: Nintendo Switch Update 2.0 and 2.5- Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

We have been hard at work for the past months, polishing, optimizing, testing, and now, we have exciting news to share: Sun Haven 2.0 and 2.5 are now available on Nintendo Switch!

After releasing Patch 2.5 to PC/Steam, we’ve managed to get Sun Haven to be in one of the most stable states it’s ever been in. We’ve been working hard on bringing that quality to Nintendo Switch, and we’re ready to release it. Thanks everyone for your patience, there is a lot of work that goes into developing the game for PC, Mac, and Switch!

Sun Haven 2.5.2 includes 5 new seasonal events, 2 new regional events, 400+ new craftable furniture items, changeable flooring, new weapons, and more! The following changes should reflect everything updated on Switch only.

Let's jump on in! 🎉

Patch Highlights:
 Seasonal Event: Furniture Festival
 Spring Event: Garden Festival
 Summer Event: Pet Festival
 Fall Event: Mushroom Festival
 Winter Event: Snow Festival
 Witherball
 Snaccoon Festival
 Changeable Flooring
 New and Updated Crafting Tables
 New Weapons: Great Swords and Hammers
 Breakable Item Update
 Worldbuilding Update
 Updated UI
 Updated Translations
 Updated Catherine Bust
 Bug Fixes

Furniture Festival:
 A new recurring event that appears every season on the 21st
 Compete against other NPCs in an auction-style bidding war for new furniture items
 New Furniture, Decorations, and Romance Merchants selling large amounts of furniture that rotate every season
 Rotating Stalls every season
 Added 80 new furniture items
 Added 14 new records
 Added 1 new pet
 Added unique gifting responses for items purchased from the Romance Merchant
 Bring your wallet and any extra currencies you may have collected to maximize your visit to the Furniture Festival

Spring Furniture Festival Stalls:
 Resources Merchant: Sells resources for crafting  of all types from around the world
 Records Merchant: Sells records with music from around the world
 Armor Merchant: Sells armor, robes, and more
 Weapons Merchant: Sells Swords, Crossbows, and more
 Great City Technology Merchant: Sells a new robotic pet for your journey

Summer Furniture Festival Stalls:
 Clothing Merchant: Sells outfits and hats from around the world
 Capes Merchant: Sells capes from around the world
 Food Merchant: Sells meals, snacks, and more from around the world

Fall Furniture Festival Stalls:

 Crops Merchant: Sells crops from any season and from all over the world

Winter Furniture Festival Stalls:

 Added 12 new clothing items

Snow Festival:
 A new event that appears on the 14th of Winter
 Added 26 new furniture items
 Added 12 new clothing items
 Added 6 new food items
 Added 1 new crossbow weapon

 A Withergate festival that appears on the 7th of Fall

 Added new furniture crafting tables: Monster Furniture Table and Elven Furniture Table
 Updated the Basic Furniture Table, Advanced Furniture Table, Anvil, and Painter’s Easel with new craftable items

New Weapons:

notes.title: Patch 2.5 on PBE now!
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers!

Happy Summer! I can’t believe spring is already over, it felt like it just got here!

We have exciting news to share: Patch 2.5: Festivals and Crafting is live right now on the PBE (PC only).

If you’d like a sneak peek at what’s coming in Patch 2.5, you can join the Public Beta Environment (PBE) and help us test this patch out before release! Join our Discord and check out #pbe-info for more information on how to opt in! If you experience any bugs on the PBE, please report them in our Discord.

Without further ado, let’s jump into a peek at Patch 2.5: Festivals and Crafting!

https://i.imgur.com/35pqiLG.gif
I’ve always wanted to dance with a prince!

Witherball
With a monster city, you need a monster party!

Come one, come all to the one-night-only Witherball to witness the benevolent Demon King re-crown Prince Darius. Dance with elites from Withergate, or assist Donovan in pulling an epic prank on the royals. The only caveat of the night… don’t get caught!

Once you have purchased your Withergate apartment, you may come across an invitation to this event. Keep your eyes open, the Witherball only comes around once a year on the 7th of Fall.

https://i.imgur.com/Z4luI9n.gif
I have to catch apples for these poor hungry Snaccoons!

Snaccoon Festival
After all those Snaccoons you helped feed, they want to give back with a Snaccoon Festival dedicated to you. 

As the honored guest, the Snaccoons have much to offer you- delicious snacks fit for any furry friend, clothes that are possibly made with snaccoon fur, furniture… possibly also made with snaccoon fur, wigs that come with the smallest snaccoons atop them. These majestic hungry creatures only ask for one thing in return, help them catch plenty of yummy apples!

Once you have received your Nel’Vari Treehouse, the Snaccoons can plan an elven party, but only during the most magical time of the year. This festival comes around on the 7th of Winter, so come hungry!


https://i.imgur.com/YU75ChQ.gif
Taking out these enemies with a big bang!

New Weapons: Great Swords and Hammers

Raise a sword or even a hammer, young adventurers!

Have you ever wanted to swing a sword like Roza, or slam a hammer down like th strongest of blacksmiths? Now you can with the new craftable Simple Great Swords and Simple Hammers. These two-handed weapons might have a slower swing, but their damage is unmatched!

These new weapons can be found at your anvil, ready to be crafted to join the fray!

https://i.imgur.com/lZR7JSv.gif
Oh, how I love crafting new furniture!
Monster, Elven, and Updated Furniture Tables

Get your hammers ready for a massive update to the furniture game. 

You will now be able to craft over 400 new furniture and decor items. These items can be found at your Sun Haven crafting tables or from two brand-new tables: the Monster Furniture Table and the Elven Furniture Table. These new crafting tables have all new furniture items that match their spook-tastic and nature-ific styles to perfectly outfit your homes around the world.

These new items range from decor to new wallpapers and even new large chests with extra storage capacity, so get ready to craft!

https://i.imgur.com/MZ4mRCi.gif
Hmmm… so many choices, how about this one!

Changeable Flooring
Roll out the red carpet- and I mean that literally! 

You can now change your home’s interior flooring! With over 30 options available at the Sun Haven General Store, there is a perfect floor for every home. Along with those options, festival-exclusive flooring is now available, which can perfectly match your festival wallpapers!

So, now you will be able to fully customize your Sun Haven home, Nel’Vari Treehouse, or your Withergate Apartment to your heart’s content!

https://i.imgur.com/KOWDMOi.gif
Don’t worry, Kara, Wornhardt’s got your back.

Worldbuilding Update
We wanted to expand on the individual characters in Sun Haven, and take time to explore the depth of their stories.

In this update, you will be able to learn more about the characters and the world in the new worldbuilding update! By investigating strange items around Sun Haven, you can get a glimpse at how characters act when you’re not around. Take a deep dive into their history and learn about how the world is tackling the looming monster city.

Be sure to keep your eye out, you never know where these stories await.

There are more details to come, but if you want to get a chance to see all of this new content before it’s released, the latest content for Patch 2.5 is available now on the PBE for PC only. Join us on Discord for the chance to play them today!

Let's get decorating, y’all! 🛠️💖

Going once, going twice... SOLD to the farmer in the front row!

Decorating your farm is one of the highlights of Sun Haven, and this means you need the highest quality furniture around. So be sure to take a trip to the monthly Furniture Festival!

Every season offers a new set of stalls, offerings from all over the world can be found here! Furniture made locally in Sun Haven, some sick records from around the world, a new little robotic pet from the Great City, and more!

All of this boils down to an intense bidding war between you and others from around the world for a chance at some of the most luxurious furniture around. This festival is only available on the 21st of the month, so come with a full wallet and empty pockets!

Get out of here you pests!

Garden Festival
Whether you’re new in town or a well-seasoned farmer, there's nothing a little time at the Garden Festival can’t offer! 

Help Catherine put on one of the prettiest festivals by fending off those pesky Spring pests trying to make a meal of her beautiful flowers! If you can fight off enough pests, you might raise the town’s spirits and be the hero to the local witch! 

The Garden Festival is only found on the 14th of Spring, so be sure to save up for some cute new clothes and plenty of flower seeds to make your farming debut in style.

https://i.imgur.com/sJcpaFp.gif
Come on Zipps, you can do it!

Pet Festival
The rarest pet eggs in the world are brought together just for the one and only Pet Festival!

I hope Liam doesn't mind me crashing his photo!

https://i.imgur.com/BOLcSII.gif
I wonder who has the best arm on Team Lucia?

Join Team Lucia or Team Darius in an epic snowball standoff of the century! Try to score direct hits on the enemy team, but avoid their snowballs. 5 hits and you’re out of the battle! So be light on your feet and be quick with your snowballs to earn the win for your team!

notes.title: Nintendo Switch Release Date
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We hope you’ve been having a wonderful November! With fall comes crispy leaves, cocoa by the fire, bundling up in blankets, and news about the Sun Haven Nintendo Switch release!

Drumroll please…

Sun Haven will be available for digital purchase in the Nintendo Switch eShop on November 29th, 2024!
(Americas region only)

You read that right, Sun Haven will be available on the Switch for the Americas region later this month on Black Friday, November 29th, at 7am PST.

These regions include:

The United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Peru.

For those of you worldwide, we will have more news to share about our release dates outside of the Americas very soon, but rest assured, Sun Haven will be coming to Switch to players worldwide over the next couple of months.

We are happy to be bringing Sun Haven to the Nintendo Switch at 30+ FPS, on par with other beloved games on the Switch, like Breath of the Wild or even Fortnite. Our team has put so much heart and soul into optimizing Sun Haven to make it run just like it would on PC, as indistinguishable as possible. In fact, there are essentially zero content differences between the two platforms as a result of all the amazing engineering work we’ve managed to accomplish. We hope you can see that effort when you get your hands on the Nintendo Switch Edition of Sun Haven later this month!

We’ve also prepared a Switch release FAQ that will hopefully answer any of your burning questions, so keep reading below for more information - including a sneak peek at some gameplay of Sun Haven on the Nintendo Switch!

Let’s jump right into it!

Sun Haven Nintendo Switch FAQ
[olist]
When is Sun Haven releasing on the Switch?
- Sun Haven will be available for digital purchase on the Nintendo Switch eShop on November 29th, 2024 at 7 AM PST.
Will there be a physical release?
- We are not planning a physical release of Sun Haven upon launch, but we are definitely considering the potential for a physical release in the future!
Can I pre-order Sun Haven on the Switch?
- Sun Haven will not be available for pre-order for the Americas region but will potentially have pre-orders for other regions.
Is Sun Haven coming to other consoles?
- We hope to port Sun Haven to other consoles like Xbox and Playstation someday, but right now our focus is on Steam and Nintendo Switch specifically!
Will the Switch version have the same content as the Steam version?
- The Nintendo Switch release of Sun Haven will match what is available right now on Steam at launch.
Is the Switch version going to be multiplayer?
- The Switch version will not have multiplayer at this time, but once Sun Haven is released on the Switch, we will be looking into how difficult it will be to add multiplayer!
Will the Switch version support cross-platform saves or cross-play?
- The Switch version will not have cross-play at this time. Your Steam and Nintendo Switch character save files will be separate!
Will the Switch version have translations?
- Yes! The Switch version of Sun Haven will be available in 19 different languages: Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, and Ukrainian.
Are you still offering Kickstarter key swaps from Switch to Steam?
- Yes we are! If you want to change your Sun Haven Backer Key from Switch to Steam, please send an email to pixelsproutdistribution@gmail.com and we will work on getting your keys swapped over as soon as possible!
When will I get my Kickstarter backer rewards?
- For those who requested Nintendo Switch keys and are from the Americas, you should receive a Nintendo Switch key at launch. As for the cosmetic rewards, those will be delivered at a later date.
Is Sun Haven going to be available on upcoming Nintendo Consoles?
- Our goal is to have Sun Haven available on all upcoming Nintendo platforms and/or consoles!
[/olist]
Now, who wants to see Sun Haven in all its beautiful, bright-screened glory on the Nintendo Switch?  

https://i.imgur.com/RYN1p0a.gif
Sun Haven on the Switch? Very cutesy. Very mindful. Very demure.

Lastly, we want to extend our sincerest apologies for the time that it’s taken to bring Sun Haven to the Switch. The port, development, testing, and approval process has taken far longer than we originally expected or anticipated, and we are very sorry for the delays and the inconvenience to all of our Switch Backers and other players without Steam who haven’t been able to play Sun Haven yet. We spent much of our time making sure that Switch players would not get an older version of Sun Haven, and would get a game that is just as good as the PC version. We completely understand your frustrations, and we’re very sorry for the delays. We are excited for the Nintendo Switch Edition of Sun Haven to be in your hands now!

notes.title: Mac Saves Issue and Cross Platform Cloud Saving
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've just made a change today that allows Steam Cloud Saves to now transfer across all devices. If you have multiple Windows and Mac devices, all your saves should now be available across all of your devices (as long as you have Steam Cloud Saving enabled, which should be the default for all Steam users)!

Unfortunately for some Mac Operating Systems, this does involve the save folder moving, meaning that your save file temporarily might not be showing up in game anymore. If you experience this issue, don’t worry, your save file is not deleted or gone!

To fix this issue, please follow these steps:
[olist]
 Go to /Users/YOURUSERNAMEHERE/Library/Application Support/com.PixelSproutStudios.SunHaven and copy your Saves folder
 Paste your saves folder into /Users/YOURUSERNAMEHERE/Library/Application Support/Pixel Sprout Studios/Sun Haven
[/olist]
Notes:

If you are having trouble finding the folder, please use the Finder -> Go To Folder, and try typing the folders above.
If you aren't seeing some of the folders, press “CMD+ Shift +  .”  to view hidden folders.

This should fix your missing saves and return them to normal. Making this move also allows your old saves to make use of the Steam Cloud Saves feature going forward if you’d also like to play on other devices now!.

Thanks everyone for your patience as we continue to improve Sun Haven. We’re sorry that this improvement involves manual work on your end, and in the future, we will try to make it so these types of changes are made automatically for all operating systems.

If you run into any issues at all, please let us know in the #report-bugs channel in our Discord server.

notes.title: Sun Haven Patch 1.4: New Region, Kids, Romance Update, and the Black Market
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s Tavielle here! 

May came and went faster than usual, it seems. The weather is getting warmer, summer break is upon us, and we know that everyone has been eager for some new content. In other words, it’s the perfect time to release an update!

Sun Haven Patch 1.4: New Region, Kids, Romance Update, and the Black Market launches today, and it’s packed to the brim with a brand new region to explore, tons of new features, 9 new DLC packs, and a bunch of fixes. Oh, and there is also full controller support for PCs and Steam Decks now. And did we mention translations for Windows, Mac, and Switch once Sun Haven’s Nintendo Switch port is complete? 

Yeah. This patch is huge.

If you didn’t get the chance to read through our Devblog, we also have news about Sun Haven’s Switch release! Patch 1.4 is the final patch filled with major features that will be released before the Nintendo Switch port releases. This means that no major content will be added to Sun Haven after Patch 1.4 until Sun Haven is released on the Switch! 

We’ll still be working on Sun Haven updates in the meantime though, so after Sun Haven is on the Switch, we have another big expansion planned! Keep an eye out for more information from us!


Now, on with the show!

https://i.imgur.com/bGjMI2J.gif
The views in the Deeps are espe-shell-y beautiful.

 Added a new region, the Brinestone Deeps
 You can now have one child with your spouse
 Added full controller support
 Updated translations and added localizations for Mac OS 
 There are now goodnight kiss cutscenes with your spouse
 You can now sleep with your spouse in their spouse room bed
 Added longer wedding vows and dialogue

 Added interactable trash cans around Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate
 The manhole cover by the Sun Haven Cafe is now open and leads to the sewers
 New fish can be caught in the sewers
 The Black Market is now accessible via the sewers with a new currency, secret merchants, and more
 Added 9 new huge DLC packs
 Added the Great Vault that allows you to buy unlimited copies of purchased DLC pack items for in-game gold

37 idol Clothing Items, 8 idol Wigs, 16 idol Furniture Items, 1 idol Mount, and 1 idol Pet. Calling all stans and fans! 32 starry Clothing Items, 7 starry Wigs, 10 starry Furniture Items, 1 starry Mount, and 2 starry Pets. If you’ve dreamed of being a guardian of the stars, then look no further! The Starlight Pack has an incredible collection of 52 starry-themed items that will make your farm look and feel magical!

18 toy Clothing Items, 2 toy Wigs, 13 toy Furniture Items, 1 toy Mount, and 1 toy Pet. If you’re looking for a set full of childlike wonder, then this is the pack for you! The Toy Pack is filled with 35 trinkets and treasures that will turn your house into the playroom of your dreams.

10 underwater Clothing Items, 1 underwater Wig, 10 underwater Furniture Items, 1 underwater Mount, and 1 underwater Pet. Get your life vests on, it’s time to dive into the Deep Sea Pack! This pack is overflowing with 23 underwater-themed items that can turn any farm into an ocean-lover's paradise.

10 astral Clothing Items, 4 astral Wigs, 10 astral Furniture Items, 1 astral Mount, and 1 astral Pet. Space lovers unite! This Celestial Pack is full of 26 star-themed items that will transform your farm into an outerspace wonderland.

notes.title: Patch 1.4 is coming, and it’s our biggest patch ever!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

It's Tavielle, from Pixel Sprout Studios!

We’re excited to share another update for Patch 1.4!

The new content for Patch 1.4 is available now on the Public Beta Environment (PBE), and we’re so close to finalizing the patch for full release soon!

Patch 1.4 will be released once it’s stabilized on the PBE and we’re able to make this massive update as bug-free as possible. 

Before we take a look at the patch contents, we want to let everyone know that we are still hiring for more sprouts here at Pixel Sprout Studios! Some of our open roles include an Executive Assistant, Level Designer, Pixel Artists, Game Designer, UI/UX Designer, and more. For more information or to apply, please head to our website below! 

https://www.pixelsproutstudios.com/jobs


Now let’s jump into all the new content for Patch 1.4!

https://i.imgur.com/Jad4NZF.gif
A brand new town awaits you from down in the Brinestone Deeps!

Brinestone Deeps:
As seen in our Discord and Twitter teasers, there’s an entire new region to explore with two new Romanceables in Patch 1.4!

A mysterious whirlpool has formed in the ocean down near the beach on your farm. Diving into the whirlpool will take you to the new region - a sprawling underwater world inhabited by nautical denizens and giant, lurking beasts. 

If you’re brave enough to traverse the wilderness, you’ll eventually find your way to a sunken city - the Brinestone Deeps, a town in the midst of a takeover by an eerie and malevolent adversary.

Embark on a brand new adventure to save the Brinestone Deeps, culminating in a battle against this imposing enemy. You’ll meet some new friends along the way, and make a few very important (and very powerful) enemies! As you fight to save the Brinestone Deeps, you’ll be able to access a new Bulletin Board with new Bulletin Board quests, and visit some of the amazing Brinestone shops - including a new general store, a magic staff shop selling weapons for mages, and a magic armor shop to buff up your stats!

Last but definitely not least, after completing the Brinestone Deeps quest line, you will unlock the brand new romanceable characters: Karish and Zaria.

https://i.imgur.com/dpEl5Ht.gif
Awww, what a cute baby!!

Kids:
Coming in Patch 1.4 is one of the most requested features from the community: Kids! Once you’re married and have your house upgraded to Tier 3, your spouse can express their interest in having a child. (This is completely optional, and you can say no!)

If you say yes, head to the Wishing Well in Sun Haven’s Eastern Wilderness to make the wish come true. The following day, a brand new room will appear in your Tier 3 home with a teeny-tiny new occupant. You will need to nurture and take care of your baby to help it grow into a toddler. 

As a toddler, they can explore Sun Haven, have quests, ask you to bring them certain items, hang out with the neighboring children,  and even listen to Jun’s stories at the library! Toddlers are highly customizable, so you can give them adorable new outfits and customization options to help them fit right into your family. If you welcome the chaos, we’ve also decided to leave all customization options unlocked, just in case you want a half-naga, half-demon baby. Who are we to deny you of your cursed child dreams?!

https://i.imgur.com/ABKuJme.gif
A new currency, secret shops, and new fish to catch in the sewers!

The Black Market:
The sewer’s manhole cover to the right of the Sun Haven Cafe is now open and leads to the grungy Sun Haven sewers! Once inside, you can catch sewer-specific fish to make a profit. If you continue forward, you will find the secret Sun Haven Black Market! 

Here you can buy and sell certain items for a unique currency called Black Bottle Caps. These Black Bottle Caps can be used to purchase furniture, clothing, and even rare eggs that hatch into different pets! There’s also a merchant who will offer to exchange your mana for health or your health for mana, which means all of you min-maxers out there can finally reach the full mana build of your dreams!

https://i.imgur.com/uj2DlMl.png
The new romanceables are here: Karish the Shark Amari, and Zaria the Water Elemental!

Romance:
There are two new Romanceables joining the large cast of Sun Haven in Patch 1.4! 


 Karish, the Aspiring Hero - A Shark Amari who looks for the best in this harsh world, Karish aspires to be the hero the Brinestone Deeps needs. Can this over-eager hero in training learn to temper expectations and help his community in ways that really matter?
 Zaria, the Redwash Mercenary - A Water Elemental known beneath the waves for her cutthroat attitude, Zaria has learned that loyalty is best sold for cash and friendship is a fool's dream. But does she truly feel that way, or is there something this ruthless corsair is trying to hide?

These new characters have dates, events, bulletin board quests, and tons of new dialogue for you to experience!

These two new romanceable characters aren’t all we have in store! We’ve also updated many aspects of romance in Sun Haven, starting with being able to sleep in the same bed as your spouse! Once your spouse moves into your Tier 3 house, you now have the option to sleep in your spouse’s bed. You can also share a special kiss with your partner in new goodnight kiss cutscenes before turning in for the day. How sweet!

There are also new seasonal walk path animations for all romanceable characters that will breathe life into the world of Sun Haven. Some of these animations include Claude playing the piano, Lucia sitting at her desk signing papers, Anne polishing a diamond, and more! These animations aren’t just seasonal - they also add ways for you to connect with the traits, hobbies, and magic of the Romanceables in Sun Haven.

Romanceable characters will now have positive and negative reactions when you accept or decline hangout and date requests! Additionally, spouses now have unique vows and more dialogue during your wedding, as well as rejection responses if you decide to say no to getting married at the altar. (You monsters!) 

https://i.imgur.com/sacBOzg.gif
Sharing a wholesome kiss with my sweet, scaly husband.

Miscellaneous Updates:

Added the Great Vault! Gone are the days of running out of or misplacing DLC items, because now you can literally jump right into your Sell Portal and be whisked away to the Great Vault, the jewel of the Great City! Here, you can also browse all of the DLCs in Sun Haven, buy extra DLC pack items for gold, and get taken directly to the DLC Steam Store pages to browse the full selection of DLC packs available.

Added Trash Cans and Destructibles. There are now interactable trash cans around Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate. Be careful not to get caught digging through the trash, though… unless you don’t mind hearing rumors about your stinky behavior. Additionally, there are new crates and barrels around all 4 towns (Hehe, you read that right! FOUR towns now!) that can be hit with your sword or scythe. Once broken, they can drop materials and other items!

Added Riddle Quests. Discover new puzzles and riddles that have been hidden around the world! These new riddles offer exclusive rewards, so keep your eyes peeled for these secret quests.

Various bug fixes.We’ve fixed tons of bugs and other issues, including: automatic collectors, automatic feeders, and feeding stations not working as intended, Shang’s first date causing you to get accidentally murdered by enemies, removed the Farmer Table’s spooky ghost animation issue, quest items not being given, Snaccoons going missing, miscellaneous typos, crafting issues with health, mana, and fish, and more!

Starting now, Patch 1.4’s new content is live on the PBE. If you’d like to see all the new content coming in Patch 1.4, you can join the Public Beta Environment (PBE) and help us test the patch before release! Join our Discord and check out #pbe-info for more information on how to opt in!

On a development note, we’re so excited to share that Patch 1.4 is the final patch filled with major features that will be released before the Nintendo Switch port releases. This means that no major content will be added to Sun Haven after Patch 1.4 until Sun Haven is released on the Switch! 

Any fixes that the community helps us with for this patch will help improve the Switch build, and we are very appreciative of everyone taking time to help us test out all of the new content that was introduced in this patch.

Thank you so much for your patience as we’ve worked behind the scenes to bring all of these major features and updates to Patch 1.4! This is the biggest update we’ve ever had, and we’re so excited to finally share it with you all!

Have a great week, and we’ll see you soon for the full release!

Tavielle, Community Manager
Pixel Sprout Studios

notes.title: Sun Haven Patch 1.3: New Romanceables and Farm Buildings
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

It’s Tavielle, the Community Manager for Sun Haven!

We’re excited to announce that Sun Haven Patch 1.3: New Romanceables and Farm Buildings is now available on Steam! This patch includes 3 New Romanceables, tons of new Farm Structures and Crafting Stations, Player Birthdays, a Combat Arena with Multiplayer Boss Battles, 6 New DLC Packs, major optimization improvements, an Encyclopedia for pets, mine progress, and items, and more!

This text is not translated yet, but we’re working to bring these new translations to PC as soon as possible!

Patch Summary:

 Added 3 New Romanceable Characters
 Major optimizations for faster load times and reducing system stress
 Added Race-Specific Dialogue
 Added Time Pausing in Chests
 Added an Encyclopedia Tab in the menu
 Added More Weather Patterns and Weather Sound Effects
 Added Player Birthdays and Birthday Celebrations
 Added 10+ Farm Structures and Buildings
 Added 12 New Shed Skins and 30+ House Customization Sets
 Added Combat Arena with Boss Fights
 Added Nel’Vari and Withergate Fruit Trees
 Added Ambient and Proximity Animations to Sun Haven and Withergate


There’s a lot that we have to share, so let’s jump right into Patch 1.3’s highlights!

https://i.imgur.com/EiwE8m6.gif
Shang, Miyeon, and Lucius are looking extra dreamy in their summer outfits!

New Romanceable Characters
The three new romanceables are finally here! You will have the option to romance and marry two brand new characters, as well as another that you may have met already...


 Shang, the Righteous Swordsman - Coming to Sun Haven with a mysterious mission, Shang spares words and forms bonds very carefully. Living under a personal code of strict honor, this swordsman may find himself forced to make a decisive choice in the fate of his future.
 Miyeon, the Timid Angel - A new arrival in Sun Haven, Miyeon has moved to town with her accomplished parents. Living under the pressures of perfection, the anxious angel has quite the journey to spread her wings and fly.
 Lucius, the Moon Attendant - The Attendants to the Moon are a special caste of Nel’Varians that exist outside the village’s normal livelihood. The Moon Elf Lucius has learned not to expect the companionship of outsiders, though this isn’t to say he isn’t hopeful…

Each new Romanceable has their own unique dates, cutscenes, dialogue, keepsakes, and wedding rings! These characters also have certain unlock requirements. Be sure to talk to other NPCs and continue through the main quests to meet these amazing new characters!
To unlock Shang, you’ll need to be on Day 8 or later, complete Peter’s A Special “Fish” quest, and then enter your farm to receive a quest that will lead you to Shang.
To unlock Miyeon, you’ll need to be on Day 11 or later, complete Solon’s Plan in Action quest, then enter the Town Hall to meet Miyeon.
To unlock Lucius, you’ll need to progress the main story and travel to Nel’Vari. His home can be found next to the Grand Tree.

For those of you who are achievement hunters, these new romanceables also bring new Steam Achievements!

We’re so happy to see all the excitement around the new Romanceable Characters. We’re excited to share that we have two more unannounced Romanceables coming later this year. Stay tuned for more information!

https://i.imgur.com/P3d7Udi.gif
Now the seasons feel even more alive!

Farm Buildings
Who doesn’t love an organized farm? We’re excited to share that Patch 1.3 has over 10 brand-new Farm Structures, Buildings, and Crafting Stations.  These structures can be used to help you process materials, store crafting stations, grow crops, or simply to help decorate your farm. These buildings include seasonal Greenhouses, Silos, Chicken Coops, Butterfly Gardens, Workshops, Ticket Counterfeiters, Mana Siphoners, and even Glorite Siphoners! 

The seasonal Greenhouses can be used to plant crops from their respective seasons! You can have one of each season, and it even comes with its own built-in waterfall and farm area. The new Chicken Coop and Nel’Vari Butterfly Garden are mini barns that not only look beautiful, but they also increase your animal limit and can be used to house Chickens and Silk Moths inside. The new crafting tables are for all you troublemakers out there who have to resort to your own underhanded devices to create your own Tickets, Mana, and Glorite against the usual forest gathering method. These crafting tables are simple and don’t take many resources to gain extra currency!

We’ve also added 12 new Shed Skins to help you theme and decorate your farm just how you like it! Some of our favorites include the Beehive Shed, the Mushroom Shed, the Ghost Shed, the Pumpkin Shed, and the Cake Shed. Sheds now also have Night Lighting to brighten up your farm area in the evenings! Additionally, thanks to player feedback, we’ve increased the Shed limit from 4 total Sheds to 12 total Sheds. Now you can make even more creative farm layouts!

Speaking of building decorations, we’ve also added over 30 new House Customization Set options, which means you can mix and match hundreds of new combinations! Some of our favorites include the Cottage Core set, the Charming set, the Castle set, and the Log Cabin set. We can’t wait to see all of your new creations!

https://i.imgur.com/hnVCSeK.gif
These shed nightlights will look amazing next to my Nel’Vari Butterfly Garden!

Player Birthdays:
Birthday parties and gifts? Yes please! You can now choose a birthday when creating a new character, or if you’re playing on an older save, you can change your birthday once at the Town Hall. On the morning of your chosen birthday, you’ll be visited by Ronald, the Sun Haven Tavern’s Barkeep. He’ll ask you to swing by the Tavern that day - if you decide to go, you’ll be able to celebrate your birthday surrounded by your friends and other invited guests. 

Don’t forget to empty your inventory before you go! The more romanceable characters you befriend, the more people you’ll have at your party - which means you’ll get even more unique gifts at the end of your birthday celebration!

https://i.imgur.com/Gfjat7L.gif
Cake, gifts, and a piñata? This is the best birthday ever!!

6 New DLC Packs:
We are excited to announce 6 new DLC packs will be available on Steam very soon!

Some of these packs are even larger than the ones we released last patch, so get ready for some amazing items! Let’s take a look:

The Trick or Treat Pack contains over 35 items, including a furniture set, 10 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This spooky-themed pack will give you a cozy fall feeling year-round. Ride around on a ghost, have a mini ghost companion follow you around, and decorate your farm to look scary good!

The Spirit Petal Pack contains over 30 items, including a furniture set, 8 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This fae-themed pack will give your farm a mystical touch. Ride around on a koi fish, tend to a fae spirit pet, and decorate your house to feel like it’s been touched by elemental energy itself!

The Rock ‘n’ Roll Pack contains over 45 items, including a furniture set, 5 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This Rock ‘n’ Roll pack will give you all the gear you need to look the part as you shred through Sun Haven with musical power. Ride around on a punk-rock horse, pet a heavy metal rat, and show everyone that your Rock ‘n’ Roll interior design isn’t just a phase.

The Cyberpop Pack contains over 55 items, including a furniture set, 10 new outfits, 1 mount, and 5 pets. In this Cyberpop Pack you’ll find an assortment of outfits and gadgets to take you a century (or five) into the future. Ride around on a hoverboard, pet some robotic and cyber-academia creatures, and decorate your farm to feel like a futuristic paradise.

The Funky Monkey Pack contains 1 hat, 2 mounts, and 1 pet. This Funky Monkey Pack will give you an adorable collection of banana-themed items to help you get around Sun Haven in style. You’d be bananas not to like this pack! 

The Dreamy Ram Pack contains 1 hat, 1 mount, and 1 pet. These are the cutest items on this side of the Sun Haven River! This Dreamy Ram Pack will give you the sweetest collection of dreamy creatures to accompany you on your adventures.

https://i.imgur.com/E6mqGNk.gif
Check out all these new DLC Packs!

That’s it for the Patch highlights! Now let’s take a full look at the Patch Notes for 1.3:

notes.content:
Hey Everyone!
It’s Bruce, the Director of Sun Haven.

We’re excited to announce that Patch 1.2: Romance and Barns Update is now available on Steam! This patch includes upgradeable barns and new farm animals for Nel’Vari and Withergate, 3 new Romanceable Characters, decorative sheds, exterior house customization, updated UI, overnight cutscene events, some new cosmetic DLC packs, and more! 

Disclaimer: the patch is currently available for all languages, but new items and text will only be in English for a short period of time until we can get it translated!

Let’s jump right in!

https://i.imgur.com/J5TNjEZ.gif
The new DLC mounts are adorable!


Barns and Animals Update:
As we talked about in the sneak peek, previously players have only been able to have four Tier 1 barns in Sun Haven. This patch, you can now upgrade your barns all the way up to Tier 3 allowing them to look cooler, have more interior space, and hold more animals! Each upgrade to each barn gives an additional 8 slots for barn animals.

Additionally, there are also some brand new regional barns - you can now place (and upgrade!) up to 4 Elven Barns in Nel’Vari, or even own a Sewer Barn in Withergate! 

To go along with all the newly upgraded barns, we’ve added some more brand-new animals and creatures that you can buy for your farm to help you collect resources and other items. There are 5 new Nel’Vari animals that can be purchased from Fonzo, and 8 new Withergate animals that can be purchased from Ur, a new Vendor in the Withergate Sewer.

https://i.imgur.com/hdY3SGi.gif
These animals will be a lot more comfortable in my upgraded barn!


New Romanceable Characters
Three new Romanceable characters have been added as well! You will have the option to romance and marry two brand new characters, and one you may recognize from before... :

	Kai, The Wayward Naga - Since washing up on shore in Sun Haven, Kai may not remember much about his past, but with your help, he might discover more about himself.
	Vivi, The Bounty Hunter - A klutzy assassin out for the high bounty on your [strike]heart[/strike] head. Now with getting to know her, maybe you’ll find out who placed the bounty…
	Wesley, The Elven Historian - This familiar face has found commonality with many people from our community, but can you get him to open his heart?

Each new Romanceable has their own unique dates, cutscenes, dialogue, keepsakes, and wedding rings! These characters also have certain features needed to be able to unlock them. For Kai, you’ll need to reach Summer Year 1. For Wesley, you’ll need to complete the Commonality questline in Nel’Vari, and for Vivi, you’ll need to complete the Glorite Miners encounter in Withergate (yes, the one in Withergate!). So be sure to keep your eyes open, talk to other NPCs, and continue through the main quests to find these new characters!

(Also note: Wesley's Dialogue is now reset!)

For those of you who are achievement hunters, these new characters also bring new Steam Achievements!

Since announcing the three new Romanceable Characters, we’ve seen a lot of player suggestions for some more beloved characters to become romanceable, and we’re excited to share that we have several more Romanceables coming later this year. Stay tuned!

https://i.imgur.com/vLFbWIk.gif
Look at them all, so cute!


Farm Building Customization
Sheds are a brand new way to customize your farm and add a bit more storage! Sheds can be crafted at a Construction Table along with the different kinds of shed skin kits which can let you change how the exteriors look. These sheds have fully customizable interiors as well, so you can store items, create role play spaces, match them to your farm, or even live in them if you want!

You can also have up to 4 on your farm at once, so you can set them up anywhere and make your own story.


https://i.imgur.com/kqCE6Jz.gif
These are perfect to make your adventure match your farm!


Player House Customization
A brand new store has opened up in Sun Haven, the Hardware Store! Here you can buy individual pieces of customization for your house to change its exterior look and appearance. Lewis, the new store owner, is selling over 135 unique roofs, walls, windows, doors, and patios, so be sure to stop by and take a look at what he has for sale! 

This feature has already been receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback, and we are happy to announce that we’ll be adding even more House customization in a future patch as well. So if you have any suggestions or ideas for house exteriors you’d like to see, please let us know over on our Discord!

Note: The house customization is only available for your Sun Haven house, and will not affect your Nel’Vari Tree House or Withergate Apartment.


https://i.imgur.com/8vNL4j1.gif
Mix pieces to make new combinations or stick with a matching set!


4 New DLC Packs:
We are excited to announce 4 new DLC packs will be available on Steam very soon, including a FREE Snaccoon Costume DLC! (Yes, that’s right, it’s free!)

These packs are quite a bit larger than the ones we released last patch, so buckle your seatbelts, or should I say, raise the sails for these new packs! Let’s take a look:


Free Snaccoon Costume DLC contains a full Snaccoon outfit - hat, shirt, pants, gloves, and a tail!

https://i.imgur.com/tjZueex.gif
Just two Snaccoons hanging around!

Set Sail DLC contains over 40 items, including a furniture set, 8 new outfits, 2 mounts, and 3 pets! This Pirate-Themed pack will put the ARRR in are you kidding me with how cool these mounts are?! Ride on the back of a Parrot, pet a monkey, and make your farm a swashbuckler’s paradise!

Mushy DLC contains over 40 items, including a furniture set, 15 new outfits, 1 mount, and 1 pet. This Mushroom-Themed pack will make you a fun-gi with the perfect cottage-core vibes. Ride a Mushroom Frog, dress up in the coziest mushroom-inspired clothes, and pet your very own Booshroom!

Ocean Shores DLC contains over 30 items, including a furniture set, 7 new outfits, and 1 mount. This Beach-Themed pack will be sure to make you ready for summer with clothes perfect for the hot weather! You can, mermaid-ify your farm, ride on the back of a manatee, and enjoy the season with this DLC.

notes.title: Patch 1.1: Epilogue, Translations, and Customization
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

It’s Bruce, the Director of Sun Haven.

We’re excited to announce that Patch 1.1: Epilogue, Translations, and Customization is now available on Steam! This patch includes Sun Haven’s Epilogue to the story, 15 new language translations, more player customization, more pets, new mounts, updated RNPC interiors, and Volume 2 of the Sun Haven Soundtrack.

Sun Haven will also be on sale for two weeks starting tomorrow morning!

Let’s jump right into the new patch!

https://i.imgur.com/3crK3BB.gif
What in the world happened to Wesley!?

Epilogue
Every epic story deserves an equally epic ending, and that’s just what we’ve got for you all in Patch 1.1! 

Once you have handled ever-spreading darkness from Dynus, Sun Haven can finally celebrate in peace. Though it seems your job is not done yet, because there’s unfinished business in Withergate and Nel’Vari that requires action! With the help of some old friends, you might just be able to make things right with the Elven Village and Monster City.


Note: If you're continuing a game from a previous save file, players who have already fought Dynus will need to fight him again, and players who chose to complete 7 altars will need to complete the final 2 in order to trigger the new Epilogue Quest.

Translations and Localization
Thanks to the additional help from our Sun Haven Discord community, we’re ready to introduce translations to Sun Haven! Players will now be able to change their language in the settings menu to the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Dutch, Danish, Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian, Turkish, Polish!

We want to give a big thank you to PotatoePet, one of our awesome community members for the help. This was a massive undertaking that has taken several months, and is only made possible thanks to the hard work by PotatoePet. In collaboration with our programmers, we were able to get this mod integrated into the vanilla version of the game so that players worldwide can now enjoy the story and entire game of Sun Haven in their own languages. We are incredibly excited to bring our game into the hands of players everywhere, and are super thankful for you PotatoePet, and the rest of our awesome community! We will be continuing to bring even more translated languages to Sun Haven in the future as well, so let us know which languages you’d like to see Sun Haven in next!

Note: A lot of these translations are computer-generated, so there may be inconsistencies or inaccuracies due to limitations.

https://i.imgur.com/pU4Jral.gif
So many more options to pick from!

Even More Character Customization
In the 1.0 patch, we introduced tons of new customization options for all races. To expand our customization further, we’ve added new customization options for the Elf, Naga, Amari, and Elemental races that didn’t get as many new cosmetic updates in the last patch. 

We have also added in even more hairstyles for most races, “none” options, and face accessories beyond just beards and mustaches. There are also over 25 brand new hairstyles to try out! Additionally, you can now select nothing in the place of many race features such as horns, halos, wings, and more; allowing even more options and combinations as you create your character. Along with that, you can also select new face customization for many races, including makeup, masks, headbands, tattoos, glasses, and more!

For those of you looking for something with a bit more bark, we have also added a lot of new pets to the Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate Pet Stores. You can now find over 135 pets between the three cities! To go along with all of those new pets, there are also new mounts to buy that can accompany you on your adventures throughout Sun Haven, Nel’Vari, and Withergate!

https://i.imgur.com/64VpsYD.gif

We also wanted to share that you can now buy Sun Haven and Sun Down Survivors in a bundle at a discount on the Sun Haven Steam Store Page. If you’re looking for a good deal and some fun games to sink your teeth into, this is the bundle for you!

And that’s everything for this patch, thank you so much for joining us on this adventure! As always, we’re continuing to improve the game and add content in future patches and updates. As such, we are aiming to release Patch 1.2: Multiplayer & Barn Update in May, and Patch 1.3: TBD in June.

Don’t forget to join our Discord to find a group to play with, ask for game help, or just hang out with the rest of our amazing community!

notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

It’s Bruce, the Director of Sun Haven.

Today is the day! The team is happy to announce that we are finally releasing Patch 1.0: Museum and Customization on Steam! This is our full release patch, which means we're packing tons of polish, as well as the Museum and Character Customization that we’ve been working on for a while! In fact, we’ve more than doubled some of the character customization options, like hair! Let's jump in! 

https://i.imgur.com/DCq3EYl.gif

Character Customization
The world of Sun Haven is diverse, home to many different races of people that encompass many different walks of life. Whether your Demon is a battle-hungry warrior or a gothy partygoer, Sun Haven reflects many aesthetics. To expand this even further, we’ve added new customization options so you can make your character to your precise taste.

There are many new hair options, new customization options for races, and new options to disable certain customizations (such as wings and horns!). There are also new color customizations for things like Angel halos and Amari ears as well. Create a new character or visit the salon in Sun Haven to explore the vast expansion of player customization!


The Museum
The gilded doors of the Sun Haven museum have finally been opened. Its vast halls of histories and knowledge are waiting to enlighten curious visitors. But there’s one problem… it’s missing all of the displays! You’ll need to help Covington, the jovial curator of the museum, fill out the missing displays and prepare the museum for a proper opening. It’s a good thing you happen to be a magic-wielding adventurer with a penchant for collecting ancient treasure.

Your generous contributions won’t go without reward, of course. Complete displays by finding and donating collections of different item types, earning wonderful and unique rewards for your hard work.


https://i.imgur.com/YnKfMKB.gif

1.0 Announcement
Sun Haven Patch 1.0 is set to release on March 10th, 2023!

It’s finally that time. 

The big pieces of content for the 1.0 Release will be the Museum, and updated character customization! For all you completionists out there, now is the time! 

https://i.imgur.com/gMF4bDd.png
A sneak peek at the Culture Section at the Museum!


While we are going to be releasing these two big things, the majority of our time will be going towards bug fixes, optimizations, and polish.

If you run into any bugs after the release of Patch 0.8, please pop into discord to share them with us.

From Wednesday, February 21st until the final build for the release, we will be extra active in our discord, as we’ll be trying to polish up everything we can. For these next few weeks, please feel free to come by and post anything you want to see fixed in the #community-suggestions channel. We’ll add it to our running list of things to polish and fix up.

Basically, until the release build is finalized, we’ll be around every single day to collect and try to solve any problems the community reports, so don’t be shy!

(keep in mind we will do our best, but we aren’t going to be able to get to everything!)


https://i.imgur.com/YrGxBP9.gif
ME HUNGRY TO SQUISH BUGS...

Our Early Access Journey

Since the beginning of early access, we’ve worked with the community to implement 140+ more features over 8 major updates to the game. We are incredibly thankful for everyone's help during Early Access. Thank you for all your suggestions, and feedback. 

While it took an additional 14 months in Early Access compared to what we initially intended, I think it’s safe to say that we’ve put in a ton of hard work to make Sun Haven a game we’re proud of. Sun Haven is a labor of love, and with so many people (ourselves included) with such high hopes for the game, it’s been an immense amount of work to live up to the great things players expect from us.

At the same, we’d also like to apologize to any folks out there who wished that the 1.0 Release would have come sooner. We’re proud of all the work and improvements to the game we made, but we also recognize that it was longer than we expected.


All things said and done, we’re definitely ready to call Sun Haven a complete game. As such, we’re releasing it fully to Steam, and are leaving Early Access. 

Looking forward, we think there are still things we want to improve. Even though Sun Haven is a complete game, we think we can still make it better, so we will be continuing to update it.

We’re happy to say that despite leaving Early Access, we would love to continue working closely with our community on future changes, just as we already have been.

We Are Still Updating Sun Haven
So to make it clear– Going forward, we will still be updating the game both in the short term and in the long term. We will be updating Sun Haven for years to come. We’re here to support the game and the community, so you can expect more content updates from us going forward.

We thank everyone for waiting patiently as we have poured our hearts into this game to make it the best game possible.

You can take a look at our Roadmap for more information on what our upcoming patches are looking like! Speaking of which…

Nintendo Switch
Lastly, we are working with Nintendo to get Sun Haven available on Nintendo Switch as soon as possible. The game has quickly been approaching the quality bar and level of optimization that we want, and as such, has been making great progress.

At this time, the ball is currently in Nintendo’s court, and we are waiting on them in order to continue making progress on our end. As a result, the release of Sun Haven on Nintendo Switch will be pushed out a bit longer, and will go Live as soon as we are given the greenlight, and can finish the port. 

Thank you once again for your patience. We’re looking forward to seeing you all on PBE, and for our 1.0 Release!

🌸☀️ 4 Seasons are coming to Sun Haven! 🍂❄️

Seasons are almost here, in all their glory! Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter have come to Sun Haven with beautiful new maps and gorgeous new music to enjoy. From the blossoms of Spring to the cozy snowfall of Winter, we’re so excited to show you how much this town can change over the course of a year.

Each season will feature unique content such as new crops, new dialogue, quests, and more! Here’s a peek at some of the things you will see as the seasons change:

- Seasonal busts and sprites for all romanceable characters
- Unique seasonal decorations
- Seasonal tokens with awesome rewards, such as themed pets and mounts
- Seasonally themed monsters
- Seasonal cooking recipes and crops

https://i.imgur.com/MXwW1Uc.png

notes.title: Friday Dev Blog #13
notes.content:
Patch 0.6: Events & Bosses is just around the corner with a couple of weeks away! 

Hey Everyone, it’s Bruce from Pixel Sprout Studios.

In our Friday Dev Blog #12, we wrote that this patch could potentially be ready in mid-September, but based on PBE discussions and testing, we found we needed more time before we felt confident that the new content was ready for players worldwide.

For the past month, we have had our noses to the grindstone in hopes of minimizing the delay, and we finally have a moment now to give an update on the patch’s final release publicly. 

Our estimation for the full release of this patch is now Friday, November 4th.

We would like to apologize for the extended delay. While game releases and major updates in the industry do have a history of extended delays, it certainly doesn’t feel great to be on that train as well from time to time. The nature of game development is about making something fun and immersive. With this, you have to take great care to make sure nothing in the game breaks immersion, which can be quite a task.

Between releasing the patch with bugs, or waiting a little bit longer to ensure everything is up to quality bar, we’ve chosen the latter- wait a little bit longer to ensure we’re delivering what players have come to expect from us. We’re very thankful for everyone’s patience and again would like to apologize for the delay.

https://i.imgur.com/S3Bf5tp.png


On a positive note. This patch is yet again, our largest patch ever. With revamping Sun Haven Town, adding in 2 new storylines, and redoing our multiplayer system, we’ve made some leaps in bounds in what Sun Haven is, and what it will be in the future. Personally, I’m really excited for what we’ll be able to do with Sun Haven for Patch 0.7: Seasons, now that Sun Haven Town is so developed.

https://i.imgur.com/HkJAHQu.png
A sneak peek at Winter! This is still a WIP (Work in Progress).

With more positive news, we haven’t heard of even a single Multiplayer disconnection issue on PBE since refactoring the Multiplayer system this patch. With this new system that we can reuse, we’re very likely to be able to continue producing multiplayer games that you can play with your friends. Disconnection free. With a lot of things in game dev, the first time is just the hardest. That’s for sure.

(And now that I’ve said we haven’t had any disconnections, I’m surely just inviting someone to jinx us… uh oh. haha)

https://i.imgur.com/ojzer1J.gif

When will the new patch be live?

We’re aiming for both Windows and Mac updates for Patch 0.6. to ship on November 4th.

What are we still working on for Patch 0.6?

Controller Support is almost finished. We are in some of the final stages of playtesting, and compatibility testing to make sure it functions correctly on multiple types of controllers. To play Sun Haven with a controller, all you’ll have to do is… Well… plug in a controller at any time.

For folks curious about the Steam Deck, we believe everything should be functional and work properly. For our Steam page receiving the Steam Deck support badge, we are likely to receive this at a later date, since it’ll take some time for Valve to verify Sun Haven. Regardless, Sun Haven is playable with controllers. Hooray!

More Multiplayer Bugfixes are still being worked on. This update should squash many common Multiplayer bugs and practically all disconnection issues, but there’s always more bugs to squash.


What isn’t ready yet?

A few features we talked about in our last Dev Update aren't fully ready yet, as we needed to spend our time on squashing bugs. These features will come as micropatches during Patch 0.6 after the initial patch release, or with Patch 0.7: Seasons.

Expanded Character Customization is a massive undertaking with hundreds of new options between all the races. The art is all done, but we haven’t had time to implement them into Sun Haven yet.

The Withergate Mines also has all of the art done, but we will need a bit more time for implementation as well. During Patch 0.6’s release, you will still be able to check out the Withergate Mines’ Subway Hub outside of the Withergate Apartment, but you won’t be able to venture into the Mines just yet.

The UI Update, as intended for Patch 0.6, is completely in the game. However, we’ve heard your feedback about the new HUD UI missing the whimsical, fantasy aesthetic that the old UI HUD had. We’re taking your suggestions into account, and we’re working to re-add some of Sun Haven’s magic to an updated HUD UI for Patch 0.7, further inspired by you. 

https://i.imgur.com/ZSuqyrH.gif

Special Thanks!
Thanks for your patience, and a big thanks to all of the folks helping with PBE testing on Discord. Speaking of which, we would like to shout out some of our most dedicated players for being amazing and incredibly helpful on Patch 0.6’s PBE testing: 

Vizzy
Ashesinthend(Yserin)Nospoons
Jet
Eranoth
Gab
Hart
Huskie Moon Fox
KokoroWorlds
Wolf Bite

You’ve all helped us improve and polish Patch 0.6 into something we can be very proud of. Thank you. And now with the team and help of the community together, we hope to be able to bring Patch 0.6: Events & Bosses to Sun Haven as soon as it's ready.

We’ll see you with an update soon!

-Bruce, Director at Pixel Sprout Studios

notes.title: Friday Dev Blog #12
notes.content:
Edited (9/13) - The team is currently finalizing a stable version for the Public Beta Environment, which should release to the public very soon. Updates for this will be posted in our Discord. Since this is a major update to the game with a lot of new content, we'll need to test the patch on the public beta environment for at least 1 week while we collect and squash bugs. As such, we'll release the patch to players worldwide as soon as we validate that the game is stable.

Hey everyone! It’s Bruce, from Pixel Sprout Studios. 

We hope everyone has been having an awesome summer so far! For us at the studio, we’ve been having a blast finishing up Sun Haven here, as we get to the last couple of patches before our big 1.0 launch. Going forward, we’re going to start posting our Dev Blogs to Steam, starting with this one! The goal for these is to keep communication up with players outside of just the official Sun Haven Discord, as well as give some sneak peeks into the next patch. If you'd like to see the rest of our previous Dev Blogs, check them out on our website. 

With that being said:

Sun Haven’s next major patch, Patch 0.6: Events & Bosses, will be coming on Wednesday, September 14th, 2022. 

This patch includes new places to explore, boss encounters, improved maps, controller support, an update to the storyline, and more. As always, features and timelines between now and the future can change, but this is the release date and general features that we’re currently planning on releasing. Without further ado, let’s jump in.

More Story
As the world grows and evolves alongside the development process, the story we made for an originally smaller game has room to grow as well. In this coming patch, we’re planning to ship changes to both the Withergate and Sun Haven questlines. The changes go all the way back to Day 1 in Sun Haven, including a new intro cutscene, which should help distill more world context when players first start the game. To see these changes, you might want to make a new character!

https://i.imgur.com/eDR3qNo.png

Character Customization
Speaking of building a new character, significant additions are coming to character customization as well. We’re still finishing them up over the next few weeks, but our plan is to ship this patch with a bunch more customization for all the races, including races that didn’t have as many options before, like Amari and Elementals. We’ll also do a pass to make sure we have a “None Selected” option for races, so you can finally be a Demon or Angel without wings.

https://i.imgur.com/DSgUr01.png

Sun Haven Town Expansion
This patch, we bumped into difficulties finding enough space for new characters and events in the Sun Haven town. It’s not so surprising considering how much the game has grown over the last year. To solve this, we had to make the town of Sun Haven a little bit larger. This includes improving existing locations to accommodate more space for characters and events, as well as adding a few new locations to explore. There’s also a museum now, which we’ll be opening for business in Patch 0.7: Seasons. 

https://i.imgur.com/RVmD1fA.png

https://i.imgur.com/GGJf7aJ.png 

Bosses and Battles
Players have been requesting some serious challenges to spice up the gameplay, so here they are! Don’t worry though– as always in Sun Haven, there are plenty of creative ways to overcome bosses through non-combative ways. Whichever way you choose, we hope you’ll enjoy these new challenges!

https://i.imgur.com/aoeQ6NX.png 

The Lantern Festival
Spring (the season Sun Haven currently always is) will include a brand-new community event: The Lantern Festival. This is a great time to meet your neighbors and explore some of the culture behind Sun Haven. Come get your free lantern and enjoy the festivities!

https://i.imgur.com/voV1bhY.png

Controller Support
We’re also rolling out controller support with this new patch, which we know many of our players have been asking for. We unfortunately weren’t able to squeeze it in for the last patch, but this time we should be good to go! Get ready to sit back and relax on the couch with a controller while you play!

Nel'Vari and Withergate Mines
Nel’Vari and Withergate are also getting their very own mining maps to explore. These updates will include a total of 20 new maps, where you can mine new resources, purchase new upgrades, and craft new items! This is the feature for players looking to max out their character, and will be an integral part of beating the game through combat.

https://i.imgur.com/iTjZlWv.png

Multiplayer Bug Fixes
For the final feature in this Dev Blog, this update includes improvements to the multiplayer system. This includes an overhaul to the base of the multiplayer system, and it should have fixes for most multiplayer issues, especially player disconnections. Remember that if anything happens, you can always roll back your character/world with the ‘Load Backups’ button on the ‘Load Character’ menu in the main menu.

Lastly, we’d like to invite players interested in participating in the development of the game to play on the Public Beta Environment. To join in, join the official Sun Haven Discord server and follow these instructions. We’ll have the newest content up on this beta environment soon. Once it’s ready, you’ll get a chance to see all the upcoming content ahead of time. Let us know what you think! 

Thank you again for your continued support and feedback to help us improve the game. We read every single suggestion and bug report in our discord channel, so please keep on posting! Make sure you take some time to explore all the changes to Sun Haven in this update coming on September 14th, 2022. 

Enjoy the rest of your summer!

Bruce,
Sun Haven Director

This is kind of a doozy of an update. Not only have we seriously revamped fishing in Sun Haven, but we’ve added the final boss fight! And there are plenty of other changes to go over too, so let’s get into it.

Let’s start with the final boss fight, since that’s easily the coolest thing since sliced anything. We’ve added more to the main quest line, including the final boss section in Withergate. You’ll find that there are multiple ways to overcome the final boss, so you may have a tough decision to make depending on the type of character you’re playing - will you seek victory in the throes of battle or use your skills to work toward a peaceful alternative? 

I’m really excited for you all to play through this content, because it includes some really unique rewards - including a LOT of cool loot!

Important note: The main quest line is NOT finished and there is more content on its way!
